column7: go-redis sets TLSConfig.InsecureSkipVerify from skip_verify=true|1 in a rediss:// admin_dsn, and connectRedis only checked that a TLS config existed, so a project admin could turn certificate verification off past the operator transport policy. connectRedis now refuses InsecureSkipVerify on the parsed options (dsn.ForbiddenOptionError, option skip_verify, DSN not quoted) unless insecure transport is allowed (then a WARNING). Covers true, 1, the encoded key skip%5Fverify and a repeated parameter; other spellings fail go-redis parsing (TestConnectRedis_SkipVerifyOtherSpellingsFailToParse). Revoke strips skip_verify and keeps verification on (TestRedisEngine_Revoke_SkipVerifyIsDroppedNotRefused). Red before the change (dial error instead of the refusal), green after.
